faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or BDS degree to be eligible for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) position.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.
